#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compressed capture transport, CSV framing and discovery bucket paths.

Campaign path: ``capture_records`` turns the base64 chunk transport of every
capture into typed records plus rejected ``[capture, ordinal]`` indices, and
``roles``/``lease_states`` bucket live ICMP evidence into the internal and
external discovery sets with their earliest causal witnesses.

Legacy CLI (unchanged development tool, ZMap6 flavoured): group responses by
/64 network and classify each responder as internal (the probed address
answered itself) or external (a different address answered), skipping aliased
networks::

    classify_responses.py aliases.txt zmap-output.csv.zst > networks.jsonl
"""
import argparse
import csv
import io
import ipaddress
import json

import os as _os
import sys as _sys

_HERE = _os.path.dirname(_os.path.abspath(__file__))
if _HERE not in _sys.path:                     # legacy CLIs run with -I
    _sys.path.insert(0, _HERE)

class _MissingZstd(Exception):
    """Placeholder so the except clause stays a tuple of exception classes."""


try:                                    # bundled read-only dependency (../deps)
    import zstandard as zstd
    ZSTD_ERROR = zstd.ZstdError
